title: StealthCup: Realistic, Multi-Stage, Evasion-Focused CTF for Benchmarking IDS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and validation of a benchmarking methodology for Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) using a Capture-the-Flag (CTF) format. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics; it contains only a standard brief section on research ethics regarding data handling and participant consent.
